{'id': '0', 'translation': "Apple Watch users in China can take part in a challenge next weekend for the country's National Fitness Day and unlock virtual rewards."}

{'id': '1', 'translation': 'According to a fitness challenge prompt about to be issued, users must complete 20 minutes of exercise on Saturday, August 8, to complete the Apple Watch challenge.'}

{'id': '2', 'translation': "However, the event is limited to users in China only, as this day marks the country's annual National Fitness Day."}

{'id': '3', 'translation': 'After completing the challenge, users can unlock four animated stickers in iOS, along with a virtual medal in the Fitness app.'}

{'id': '4', 'translation': 'Apple regularly hosts fitness activity challenges around the world, encouraging Apple Watch users to experience different types of exercise.'}

{'id': '5', 'translation': 'The latest Apple Watch Series 11 is now on sale, starting at US$299.'}

{'id': '6', 'translation': 'Get the most out of your Apple products.'}
